codex.mode: one independent blinded batch of 33 items; no tools or history; existing ChatGPT sign-in

gate_findings.strict_phishing_classification: fails: 4 phishing cases already held as generic spam; at most 71/75 could receive correct phishing label, below 95%
gate_findings.legitimate_false_positives: 1/10 in pilot, caused by Rspamd; insufficient evidence for <=2% full-cohort rate
gate_findings.instruction_and_tail_challenges: 8/8 and 4/4 detected in blinded Codex probe
gate_findings.harmful_mail_quarantine: All 20 spam/phishing cases in this pilot were flagged; secondary safety measure, not a replacement for existing class gates

limitations: Historical raw MIME lacks trustworthy live SMTP envelope/authentication context.
Public archives may occur in model pretraining; absence cannot be established.
The first 30 local-stage outcomes were already exposed; a model-blind comparison is not a fresh independent deployment validation.
Batch latency cannot establish per-message API latency.
No production Codex/OpenAI API integration, provider switch or automatic enablement.
No antivirus coverage claim; no custom training or paid threat feeds.
